title: Niagara Falls Walk and Cruise: A Canadian Side Experience
includes: Scenic walk along Niagara Parkway with stunning viewpoints
Expert-guided walking tour of Niagara Falls
If option seleted: Skip-the-ticket-line Niagara City cruise ticket (seasonal: May–October)
Transportation after the tour (tour ends at Niagara City Cruises) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your Niagara adventure begins at Casino Niagara Falls, where you’ll meet your friendly local guide. From there, enjoy an easy 500m walk total on a mix of paved sidewalks and natural park paths through the stunning Oakes Garden Theatre.

Built into the natural contours of the landscape, Oakes Garden features a curved pergola overlooking a central amphitheater, plus a serene Japanese-style garden with a lily pond and charming wishing bridge—a tranquil escape in the heart of Niagara Falls. 

Continue along the scenic Niagara Parkway for epic views of the American Falls, Bridal Veil Falls, and Horseshoe Falls, with stories, legends, and insider tips from your guide. The tour ends at Niagara City Cruises—poncho on, then board Voyage to the Falls for an unforgettable ride into the mist.

In summer, don’t miss our special Fireworks Walk & Cruise experience. 8:45 PM departure offered on weekends only.
